Title: April 23, 2026 Boulder City Council Study Session

Topic1.Title: Boulder Municipal Airport Future: Indefinite Operation vs. Closure Opportunity
Topic1.Summary: Staff presented an update on the airport's future, including the dismissed FAA lawsuit, the community conversation results, and financial projections showing scenario two would require about $600,000 per year in local subsidy. Council discussed grant assurances in perpetuity, noise and leaded fuel limits, and redevelopment potential of the land. Council members debated the financial and legal implications and a straw poll favored scenario one, continuing airport operations indefinitely. Staff was directed to bring back a formal action to memorialize the direction.

Topic2.Title: Power Resilience and Public Safety Power Shutoffs
Topic2.Summary: Staff presented on increasing public safety power shutoffs and outages driven by wildfire mitigation and aging infrastructure. The presentation covered Excel Energy's hardening work, reliability metrics, and risk zones, along with a phased community engagement plan including a summer workshop and a fall community council forum. Council expressed support for the approach and asked about accountability, timelines, relocation considerations, and cross-departmental trade-offs. Council confirmed alignment with the proposed approach.
